environment_profiles.setting: Neon-lit skyscraper rooftop party at night
environment_profiles.weather: Clear, starry night with a light breeze
key_visual_elements: Towering futuristic skyscrapers in the background
Glowing neon signage in cyan and magenta
Warm golden string lights draped overhead
Polished concrete floor reflecting the city lights
environment_profiles.lighting: Warm realistic lighting with rich volumetric glows and soft neon reflections
environment_profiles.reference_prompt: A bustling neon-lit skyscraper rooftop party at night, 3D animated Pixar style. In the background, a sprawling futuristic cityscape glows with thousands of soft, warm lights under a clear starry sky. The rooftop is decorated with glowing pink and cyan neon signs, warm golden string lights, and modern glass barriers. Elegant robot and human guests mingle around high-top tables. The atmosphere is vibrant and warm, with rich volumetric lighting casting soft colorful reflections on polished metallic and concrete surfaces.

key_visual_elements: DJ booth with glowing holographic wave displays
Shimmering confetti drifting in the air
Pulsing stage speakers with integrated ring lights
environment_profiles.lighting: Dynamic pulsing spotlights, colorful rim lighting, and glowing floor emission
environment_profiles.reference_prompt: An energetic rooftop dance floor at night, 3D animated Pixar style. The floor consists of glowing, interactive LED tiles shifting between electric blue and magenta. In the background, a DJ booth pulses with colorful holographic wave patterns, and a warm-lit crowd of stylized characters cheers. Shimmering confetti drifts through the air, catching the bright pink and orange spotlights. The lighting is warm and dynamic, casting beautiful colorful rim lights on the surroundings, creating an upbeat and magical atmosphere.
